_note: Our own A to E scales, like a nutrition label. Every cut-off is here so anyone can argue with it. Lower is better on every scale except jobs_per_mapped_site and straight_talk.

pue.why: E starts at the industry average (1.54). A is about the best the big cloud companies report.

wue.why: E starts at the industry average Amazon's page implies (0.84).

tax_usd_per_home.why: Our own scale. State sales tax not collected, shared across every Texas home.

jobs_per_mapped_site.unit: jobs per data center on the map, higher is better
jobs_per_mapped_site.why: Our own scale. The good side of the ledger: it pulls the overall letter up.

straight_talk.why: Holds up = 1, holds on paper only = 0.5, can't be checked = 0.25, does not hold up = 0. Averaged.
